beta.notes:
New in this version:
• Early access for Mac: this build updates itself from its own early-access channel and leaves a Work Sample Buddy 4 install's update setting alone.
• A new look: the beach course dashboard, calm sky working screens, and Light, Dark or Match my computer in Settings, switched live.
• Settings reorganised into eight pages in four groups, with an Easy/Advanced switch; local source folders and Drive folder scanning leave Settings.
• RoboSpark work arrives through the PCA extension: set it up there once, and Buddy picks it up with each sync and files it to the right student.
• Choose and Prepare: compare papers side by side with the rubric in view; Can't use shows the next paper and remembers the ones you turned down.
• Grade options are where you grade: Edit grade options in the grading dropdown and on Verify's grade chips.
• Grades and comments entered directly in Schoology are picked up, and you can open the exact Schoology assignment from a task.
• Work sample packet rows: finished students fold into a quiet strip, ready rows show a green Finalize, and a settled LP's rows rest on the beach.
• Patch tools on the grade page and Verify desk: replace a page, adjust a page, or correct the work date.
• Setup is three steps and no longer asks for your name; startup pop-ups become arrival screens, a banner and To-do rows; the Quick Start guide is repainted.

Fixes:
• Missing or damaged samples and packets are rebuilt when you open them; folder renames interrupted part-way are recovered.
• If the workspace goes offline mid-session, Buddy switches to read-only with a reconnect bar instead of failing writes.
• Uncertain family-email confirmations are reconciled, and missing-work messages keep their submission links.
• Newer assignment revisions are compared before they replace a validated sample, and replacement uploads need a fresh decision.
• Prepare LP with no file yet keeps its rows, Compare and Prepare button honest; comparing work with no local file no longer crashes.
• Course cards open the header LP's work, never another LP's; long names and badges no longer collide.
• Tooltips read clearly in light and dark; a live theme switch no longer rebuilds the window twice.
• PDF panning, zoom and page rotation controls stay reachable; lossy PDF annotation rebuilds are refused.
• OCR uses the models bundled with the app, and a compromised certificate root was removed from the app's certificate bundle.
